metadata.purpose: Complete specification for building the React interviewer dashboard for the Blockd interview security platform
metadata.description: This document provides comprehensive specifications for building the interviewer frontend application. The interviewer app is a React web application used by interviewers to create, monitor, and manage interview sessions with real-time security monitoring, AI detection, and video streaming capabilities.

implementation-notes.note: Implement automatic token refresh using axios interceptors. When a request fails with 401, attempt to refresh the token using the refresh endpoint. If refresh fails, logout the user.
WebSocket connection should automatically reconnect with exponential backoff on disconnect. Use the reconnection strategy defined in the websocket-specification section.
Gaze data should be throttled/buffered to prevent performance issues. Store only the last 1000 points in the realtime store and use a circular buffer approach.
Implement sound alerts for critical security events. Use the Web Audio API or a sound notification library. Allow users to toggle this in settings.
Use React Query's staleTime and cacheTime appropriately. Sessions list can be stale for 30s, but session details should be refetched more frequently during active sessions.
Consider implementing optimistic updates for session actions (start, end) to provide immediate feedback while the API call is in progress.

security-considerations.consideration: Store JWT tokens in memory (Zustand) rather than localStorage for XSS protection. Use the persist middleware only for non-sensitive state.
Implement CSRF protection if using cookies for any authentication.
Sanitize all user inputs before displaying to prevent XSS attacks.
Use HTTPS in production for all API and WebSocket connections.
Implement rate limiting awareness - show user-friendly messages when rate limited.
